# Configuration Reference

## Configuration boundary

Lattice keeps provider credentials in the existing secret-store boundary. Documentation examples never contain credentials, local usernames, absolute home paths, or live endpoints.

| Area | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Provider registry | native persisted state | disconnected/lazy | Providers are not all connected at startup. |
| Studio transport | resolved environment capability | unavailable when unsupported | Platform resolution is authoritative. |
| MCP | native stdio or Streamable HTTP | local daemon | Northbound catalog remains a small broker surface. |
| Results | immutable result store | bounded inline response | Large outputs become result references. |
